svg.title: A slow valve with and without measured-position tracking
svg.desc: With measured-position tracking the valve request jumps with the setpoint step but stays within 2 points of the stem from 5 seconds, and the stem reaches 85 percent after about 20 seconds; the water peaks at 37.02 degrees Celsius and settles from 29.5 seconds. Tracking only the bounded target, the request runs to 100 percent from 5.6 to 23.0 seconds, up to 20.1 points ahead of the stem; the stem overshoots to 91.5 percent and the water to 37.98 degrees.
svg.text: A slow valve with and without measured-position tracking
Control Studio validation trials · 35 → 37 °C · stem at most 0.5 %/s · Kp 6.95, Ki 1.37, β 0.8, Tf 1 s, Tt 1 s · numbers answer the predictions
Stem 75 → 85 % in about 20 s; from 5 s the request stays within 2 points
Request at 100 % from 5.6 s to 23.0 s, up to 20.1 points ahead
